data.narrative:
Magdrive is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson that has raised $22.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 13 peers across the space and aerospace sector, comprising 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private firms including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Of three valuation methods tested, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. The peer-median approach was inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer overlap—while 14 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three companies met simultaneous same-stage and comparable-valuation-tier filters. Public-comp anchoring could not be deployed because the target's revenue is not on file, limiting utility of the sector P/S median of 24.6x across public comparables. The stage-progression method, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $22.5M raised proxy, yields an implied valuation of $56M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $48M to $65M, centered on $56M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific subsector and the absence of recent private transaction data for narrow peer validation. Additional disclosure of financial metrics or near-term funding signals would materially reduce estimation uncertainty.
